title: Eye Balm

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Eye Creams & Treatments > Eye Care > Skincare
specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, parabenFree, oilFree, alcoholFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Good for: Anti-Aging✓ Good for: Dark Circles✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Stick Formula

What it is: An eye balm stick that quickly cools, hydrates, and rejuvenates the under-eye area.


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Caffeyelike Vita: Reduces the appearance of dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines.

- Floral Water: Calms and soothes.

- Hyaluronic Acid: Helps attract and retain moisture to give the appearance of plumper skin.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan and cruelty-free.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Glide once under each eye after cleansing and before moisturizing.

-Let the balm absorb fully before applying other products.

-Use in the morning and night, for an instant refresh.

Ingredients+

-Caffeyelike Vita: Reduces the appearance of dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines.

-Floral Water: Calms and soothes.

-Hyaluronic Acid: Helps attract and retain moisture to give the appearance of plumper skin.


Centaurea Cyanus Flower Water, Butylene Glycol, Bis-PEG-18 Methyl Ether Dimethyl Silane, Sodium Stearate, Propanediol, Glycerin, Pentylene Glycol, Caprylic/Capric/Myristic/Stearic Triglyceride, Ethylhexylglycerin, Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Chloride, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Aqua/Water/Eau, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Hydroxide, Coleus Forskohlii Root Extract, Tocopherol.
